## Cisco Systems Falls ~8% After Record FY26 Results Despite AI-Driven 2027 Guidance

A post-earnings selloff on record results with AI-positive forward guidance signals the market is skeptical that CSCO can translate AI tailwinds into durable margin expansion or genuine competitive differentiation from cloud-native networking rivals. This is a key datapoint on whether legacy networking incumbents can credibly participate in the AI infrastructure cycle.

- CSCO declined approximately 8% following full-year FY26 results, which were characterized as record
- The company provided an AI-driven 2027 outlook, yet the market reaction was sharply negative
- Coverage suggests valuation or margin concern—not execution shortfall—drove the selloff
- Enterprise AI adoption, networking competitive landscape, and margin trajectory themes are all implicated
